about: INDIRECT (docs/specs/exsheet-functions ticket 18; ADR-0124's notes of 2026-10-10, 2026-10-12 and 2026-10-14; ADR-0049): A1-style text naming a cell or a range of the same Sheet, with or without its own qualifier, read as it stands after the recalculation (volatile). Its text is not rewritten by an insertion or a deletion. Observed by the seventeenth Windows run, the two area passes of 2026-10-12 and Windows run 18a, and read as Excel reads them: R1C1 text (a1 FALSE, 0, a blank or left empty) with R and C each a number counted from 1, a leading 0 included (R3C2, R03C2), an offset in brackets from the Formula's own cell, +, 0 and -0 included (R[1]C[-1], R[+1]C[-1], R[0]C[-1], R[-0]C[-1]), or no number, the Formula's own row or column (RC[-1], R[2]C), in any combination, with leading 0s anywhere (RC2, R2C, R[1]C[0], R[01]C[-1], R3C02); a row part alone a whole row (R3, R[1]), a column part alone a whole column (C2, C[-1]); two parts of the same kind joined by ':' the rectangle they span (R2C2:R5C2, R2:R3, C1:C2, RC[-1]:R[1]C[-1], R[1]C[-1]:RC[-1]); a cell joined to a whole column, the cell's row across the columns they span (R2C2:C3, B2:C2), and a whole row joined to a cell, the rows they span down the cell's column (R3:R2C2, B2:B3); other parts of two kinds joined, which name no place, #REF! (R2C2:R3, R3:C2, C2:R3); one cell followed by #, its Spill Range (R1C1#, RC[-1]#), #REF! where the cell does not spill; A1#, read as the typed A1# is, #REF! where A1 does not spill; a structured reference's text, read as the typed Table[Column] is, in either style, in double brackets too; and text that names no place, #REF!: another Sheet's name, in either style (Sheet2!B2, Sheet2!R3C2), a column past XFD (XFE1), A1 text read as R1C1 (B3) and R1C1 text read as A1 (R3C2), empty text, a number, a space before the Reference, a leading =, two ranges with a space between them, an intersection (B2:B5 B3:C3), and a table or column that does not exist. Read by the rule those settle, and asked by INDIRECT-101 to INDIRECT-103 and INDIRECT-105: the extent of a cell joined to a whole column and of a whole row joined to a cell, whose observed sums do not tell the rectangle from whole rows (INDIRECT-075 and INDIRECT-076 read text and blanks beside it); and two joins, rows and then columns (R2:R3C2:C3), #REF! as other text that is not R1C1 notation is. Another Sheet's name in R1C1 style is #REF! whatever follows it, as in A1 style. #REF! too, read by the rule those settle and asked by no case: other A1 text that goes on past its Reference, the engine's rule generalised from the intersection (INDIRECT-021); a row past 1048576 in A1 style, as XFE1's column is (2026-10-12, decided with the user: A1 text past the Sheet's edge stays #REF!); and other text that is not R1C1 notation, read in R1C1 style, as B3 is (INDIRECT-035). #VALUE! until a run observes them, where the observed answers leave the readings apart. In R1C1 style: a row or column number 0 (INDIRECT-073); a row or column number past the Sheet's edge (R1048577C2, R2C16385), whatever an offset beside it reads, which could name no place, as XFE1 does in A1 style, or a place, as an offset past the edge does (2026-10-12, decided with the user: refused with #VALUE! until Excel is asked, while A1 text past the edge stays #REF!, as XFE1 was observed to be; INDIRECT-074 asks it), and INDIRECT-095 asks a column; an offset past the Sheet's edge, which Excel reads as a place (INDIRECT-052 is 0, a blank cell) though no run has told whether it wraps round to the far side or stops at the edge (INDIRECT-082 to INDIRECT-084 ask it); and a whole column joined to a cell (C3:R2C2), whose column part could take the cell's row, as a whole row joined to a cell takes its column, or which could name no place, as a cell joined to a whole row does (2026-10-14, after run 18a; INDIRECT-104 asks it). In either style: # after a range, a row or a column, whatever the parts joined (A1:A2#, A:A#, R2C2:R3C2#, R3#, C2#, R2C2:R3#), which no run has observed and whose readings part: no place, the Spill Range of the first cell, the cells themselves with the # passed over, or the first cell joined to the second's Spill Range, A1:(A2#) (INDIRECT-090 to INDIRECT-092, INDIRECT-094, INDIRECT-096 and INDIRECT-097 ask it); and # inside a join, after its first part (A1#:A2, A1#:A2#, 1#:2, R1C1#:R2C1, R1#:R2), which no run has observed and whose readings part: no place, the first cell's Spill Range joined to the second part, (A1#):A2, the # bound to the cell before it as A1# is read, or the cells themselves with the # passed over (INDIRECT-098 and INDIRECT-099 ask it). Another Sheet's name is judged first, by the rule INDIRECT-008 settles, so Sheet2!A1:A2# and Sheet2!A1#:A2 are the engine's #REF!. #VALUE! by decision (ADR-0049's rule 2, a Linked Table is read by key, never by position; 2026-10-12, decided with the user: the bare name stays #VALUE!, in either style): a declared Linked Table's bare name, in either style, which Excel reads as the table's data (INDIRECT-043 and INDIRECT-053 to INDIRECT-057 record Excel's answers).

cases.engineDiffersByDecision: ADR-0124 (2026-10-12): a # inside an R1C1 join is #VALUE! until a run observes it, as in A1 style, since the observed answers read # after one cell only (INDIRECT-060) and the readings part; the engine answered #REF! before, as text that is not R1C1 notation; recorded, so that a run reads Excel's answer

cases.description: INDIRECT to a refused cell does not let IFERROR catch it: B1 is MROUND(6.05,0.1), refused, which Excel answered 6 (MROUND-001); what IFERROR(INDIRECT("B1"),0) gives is asked
cases.engineDiffersByDecision: ADR-0047 (2026-10-12, decided with the user: a refusal is never caught, anywhere): MROUND's fractional multiple is refused (ADR-0047), and a Formula that reads the refused cell through INDIRECT is refused, where IFERROR gave 0 before

cases.description: Engine's answer, Excel to be asked: R2C2:C3 is the cell's row across the columns the parts span, B2:C2, two columns, as INDIRECT-075's sum is read; the whole of row 2, which that sum does not rule out, would be 16384

Engine's answer, Excel to be asked: R3:R2C2 is the rows the parts span down the cell's column, B2:B3, one column, as INDIRECT-076's sum is read; the whole of rows 2 and 3, which that sum does not rule out, would be 16384
Engine's answer, Excel to be asked: R2C2:C3 over numbers on both sides of it in row 2, A2 4000, B2 1, C2 20 and D2 300, sums B2:C2, 21; the whole of row 2 would be 4321, and B2 alone 1

Refused until Excel is asked: R1C1 text joining a whole column to a cell, C3:R2C2, the order no run has asked; the column part could take the cell's row, as a whole row joined to a cell takes its column (INDIRECT-076), and sum B2:C2, 1.333, or the text could have to give its rows before its columns, as a cell joined to a whole row names no place (INDIRECT-058), and be #REF!
cases.engineDiffersByDecision: ADR-0124 (2026-10-14, after run 18a): a whole column joined to a cell in R1C1 text is #VALUE! until a run observes it, since run 18a read a cell joined to a whole column and a whole row joined to a cell as places (INDIRECT-075, 076) and a cell joined to a whole row as none (INDIRECT-058), and the readings of this order part; the engine answered #REF! before, as parts of two kinds joined; recorded, so that a run reads Excel's answer

cases.description: Engine's answer, Excel to be asked: R2:R3C2:C3, rows joined and then columns joined, is text that goes on past an R1C1 Reference and names no place, #REF!, as other text that is not R1C1 notation is (INDIRECT-035); read as rows 2 to 3 across columns 2 to 3, which INDIRECT-075 and 076 would also give, it would sum B2:C3, 46.333
